events.name: Fireside Chat with Richard Socher, Recursive
events.description:
Join SPC's  Pretraining Forum for a fireside chat with Recursive CEO Richard Socher.
Richard Socher is the CEO and co-founder of Recursive, a company building self-improving superintelligence to automate knowledge discovery, and the CEO and co-founder of You.com, a web search infrastructure provider for AI. He is also the co-founder and managing partner at AIX Ventures. Richard previously served as chief scientist and EVP at Salesforce, having joined through the 2016 acquisition of his first AI startup MetaMind. He is widely recognized as having brought neural networks into the field of natural language processing, inventing the most widely used word vectors, contextual vectors and prompt engineering. He earned his Ph.D. in computer science from Stanford University, where he also served as an adjunct professor. He has over 250,000 citations. He is the author of the national bestseller, The Eureka Machine: Why AI Is the Key to Unlocking a New Era of Scientific Discoveries.
Agenda: 
1:30pm—Doors Open
2:00pm-3:00pm—Fireside Chat

events.name: SPC Post Training Forum: Fireside w/ Harvey CRO, Adam Sadovsky
events.description:
How do you bridge the gap between frontier models passing the bar exam and making them good enough to practice real law?
Join us for a technical conversation with Adam Sadovsky, Chief Research Officer at Harvey, on what it takes to push the frontier of vertical AI in the legal domain. We'll get into:
Turning expert lawyer workflows into data, environments and reward signals for post-training and RL
Evaluating models where there's no single right answer and the stakes are high
Post-training on open-weight models compared with relying on frontier labs
About Adam: Adam joined Harvey after serving as a CVP of AI at Microsoft, where he led post-training for models like MAI-Thinking-1. Before that, he was a distinguished software engineer and senior director at Google DeepMind, where he worked on the Gemini engineering leadership team and led efforts spanning large language model post-training, capabilities, tooling, and infrastructure.

2:30pm - Doors Open
3:00pm - Fireside Begins
Moderated by Nick Mecklenburg (CTO, Whitney AI)

events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host John Bai for our Design Chat series with Soleio.
Event Details
4:30pm: Doors Open

John Bai is a product designer at SpaceXSI, working on AI-native product experiences across Grok Bot, X, and Cursor. Over the past decade, he has designed products at Plaid, Lyft, and Dropbox. A RISD graduate based in New York, he explores how emerging tools are reshaping the role, process, and craft of product design.
